Woman Dies in Delhi Car Collision; Driver Detained

A 70-year-old woman died in Delhi's Narela area after her WagonR was involved in a collision with a Mercedes. The WagonR then crashed into a parked vehicle. The Mercedes driver, identified as Subham Sharma, was detained at the scene. Reports indicate Sharma was returning from a party. The victim's family alleges the Mercedes driver was drunk and speeding.
